title: Vesper and the Promise
author: Marguerite Iversen
blurb: Felix Vasquez, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
